<?php
/**
 * IoT Device Firmware - Cross-Service Authentication Module
 * Handles LDAP-based authentication for device mesh network
 * Version: 2.4.1-firmware
 */

namespace IoT\Auth;

class LdapSanitizer {
    private static $dangerous_chars = ['\\', '*', '(', ')', '\0'];
    private static $escaped_chars = ['\\5c', '\\2a', '\\28', '\\29', '\\00'];
    
    /**
     * RFC 4515 compliant LDAP filter escaping
     */
    public static function escapeFilter(string $input): string {
        return str_replace(self::$dangerous_chars, self::$escaped_chars, $input);
    }
    
    /**
     * Escape DN components per RFC 4514
     */
    public static function escapeDN(string $input): string {
        $chars = [',', '\\', '#', '+', '<', '>', ';', '"', '='];
        $escaped = ['\\,', '\\\\', '\\#', '\\+', '\\<', '\\>', '\\;', '\\"', '\\='];
        return str_replace($chars, $escaped, $input);
    }
}

class DeviceIdentity {
    private string $deviceId;
    private string $meshGroup;
    private int $trustLevel;
    
    public function __construct(string $deviceId, string $meshGroup, int $trustLevel) {
        $this->deviceId = $deviceId;
        $this->meshGroup = $meshGroup;
        $this->trustLevel = $trustLevel;
    }
    
    public function getDeviceId(): string { return $this->deviceId; }
    public function getMeshGroup(): string { return $this->meshGroup; }
    public function getTrustLevel(): int { return $this->trustLevel; }
}

class CrossServiceAuthenticator {
    private $ldapConn;
    private string $baseDN;
    private array $serviceRegistry;
    private string $bindDN;
    private string $bindPassword;
    
    public function __construct(array $config) {
        $this->baseDN = $config['base_dn'];
        $this->bindDN = $config['bind_dn'];
        $this->bindPassword = $config['bind_password'];
        $this->serviceRegistry = $config['services'] ?? [];
        $this->ldapConn = ldap_connect($config['ldap_host'], $config['ldap_port']);
        ldap_set_option($this->ldapConn, LDAP_OPT_PROTOCOL_VERSION, 3);
        ldap_bind($this->ldapConn, $this->bindDN, $this->bindPassword);
    }
    
    /**
     * Authenticate a device for cross-service access
     * Uses two-phase lookup: first resolves device identity, then checks service ACL
     */
    public function authenticateDevice(string $deviceToken, string $targetService): ?DeviceIdentity {
        $tokenParts = $this->parseDeviceToken($deviceToken);
        if ($tokenParts === null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Phase 1: Resolve device identity from token claims
        $identity = $this->resolveIdentity($tokenParts);
        if ($identity === null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Phase 2: Verify service access permission
        if (!$this->checkServiceAccess($identity, $targetService)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $identity;
    }
    
    /**
     * Parse firmware device token format:
     * BASE64(deviceId:meshGroup:nonce:hmac)
     */
    private function parseDeviceToken(string $token): ?array {
        $decoded = base64_decode($token, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $parts = explode(':', $decoded);
        if (count($parts) !== 4) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Validate HMAC (simplified for firmware - uses shared secret)
        $payload = $parts[0] . ':' . $parts[1] . ':' . $parts[2];
        $expectedHmac = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->getSharedSecret());
        
        if (!hash_equals($expectedHmac, $parts[3])) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return [
            'device_id' => $parts[0],
            'mesh_group' => $parts[1],
            'nonce' => $parts[2]
        ];
    }
    
    /**
     * Resolve device identity via LDAP lookup
     * Applies sanitization to prevent injection
     */
    private function resolveIdentity(array $tokenParts): ?DeviceIdentity {
        $deviceId = LdapSanitizer::escapeFilter($tokenParts['device_id']);
        $meshGroup = $tokenParts['mesh_group'];
        
        // Build search filter - device must exist in claimed mesh group
        $filter = $this->buildIdentityFilter($deviceId, $meshGroup);
        
        $searchDN = "ou=devices,ou=" . LdapSanitizer::escapeDN($meshGroup) . "," . $this->baseDN;
        
        $result = @ldap_search($this->ldapConn, $searchDN, $filter, ['cn', 'trustLevel', 'meshGroup']);
        if ($result === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $entries = ldap_get_entries($this->ldapConn, $result);
        if ($entries['count'] !== 1) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return new DeviceIdentity(
            $entries[0]['cn'][0],
            $entries[0]['meshgroup'][0],
            (int)$entries[0]['trustlevel'][0]
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * Build LDAP filter for identity resolution
     * The deviceId is pre-sanitized; meshGroup used for structural validation
     */
    private function buildIdentityFilter(string $sanitizedDeviceId, string $meshGroup): string {
        // Normalize mesh group for filter comparison
        $normalizedGroup = $this->normalizeMeshIdentifier($meshGroup);
        
        return "(&(objectClass=iotDevice)(cn={$sanitizedDeviceId})(meshGroup={$normalizedGroup}))";
    }
    
    /**
     * Normalize mesh group identifier for consistent lookups
     * Handles legacy firmware format conversion (hex-encoded -> ascii)
     */
    private function normalizeMeshIdentifier(string $identifier): string {
        // Legacy firmware sends hex-encoded mesh identifiers
        if ($this->isHexEncoded($identifier)) {
            $decoded = hex2bin($identifier);
            if ($decoded !== false) {
                // Always sanitize after decoding
                return LdapSanitizer::escapeFilter($decoded);
            }
        }
        // Modern firmware sends plain identifiers - sanitize
        return LdapSanitizer::escapeFilter($identifier);
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if string appears to be hex-encoded
     * Legacy devices use hex encoding for mesh group names
     */
    private function isHexEncoded(string $str): bool {
        return strlen($str) > 0 && strlen($str) % 2 === 0 && ctype_xdigit($str);
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify device has access to target service
     */
    private function checkServiceAccess(DeviceIdentity $identity, string $targetService): bool {
        $service = LdapSanitizer::escapeFilter($targetService);
        $device = LdapSanitizer::escapeFilter($identity->getDeviceId());
        
        $filter = "(&(objectClass=serviceACL)(serviceName={$service})(allowedDevice={$device}))";
        $searchDN = "ou=services," . $this->baseDN;
        
        $result = @ldap_search($this->ldapConn, $searchDN, $filter, ['serviceName']);
        if ($result === false) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $entries = ldap_get_entries($this->ldapConn, $result);
        return $entries['count'] > 0;
    }
    
    private function getSharedSecret(): string {
        return file_get_contents('/etc/iot/mesh.key');
    }
}

// Firmware entry point for authentication requests
function handleAuthRequest(array $request): array {
    $config = [
        'ldap_host' => getenv('LDAP_HOST') ?: 'ldap://127.0.0.1',
        'ldap_port' => (int)(getenv('LDAP_PORT') ?: 389),
        'base_dn' => getenv('LDAP_BASE_DN') ?: 'dc=iot,dc=local',
        'bind_dn' => getenv('LDAP_BIND_DN') ?: 'cn=firmware,dc=iot,dc=local',
        'bind_password' => getenv('LDAP_BIND_PW') ?: '',
        'services' => []
    ];
    
    $auth = new CrossServiceAuthenticator($config);
    
    $token = $request['device_token'] ?? '';
    $service = $request['target_service'] ?? '';
    
    if (empty($token) || empty($service)) {
        return ['status' => 'error', 'code' => 400];
    }
    
    $identity = $auth->authenticateDevice($token, $service);
    
    if ($identity === null) {
        return ['status' => 'denied', 'code' => 403];
    }
    
    return [
        'status' => 'granted',
        'code' => 200,
        'device_id' => $identity->getDeviceId(),
        'mesh_group' => $identity->getMeshGroup(),
        'trust_level' => $identity->getTrustLevel()
    ];
}
